summary: All 655 tests pass in the merged state. Build is clean. Locales check exits 0. No existing coverage weakened.

suites.build: success — 8.51 MB output, nitro build complete

FunnelStepForm.identity.spec.ts.assessment: load-bearing — each test mounts the real FunnelStepForm with a typed FunnelStep prop carrying explicit id/next/canvasPosition, triggers a DOM form submit, and asserts on the emitted payload. Removing the fix (the spread that re-attaches id/next to the emitted step) causes the id assertion to fail. The DELAY test additionally mutates a field the form owns (delayValue) to confirm the edit is preserved alongside the identity fields — preventing a silent partial-revert. All three step types (DELAY, ADD_TAG, SUBSCRIBE_TO_FUNNEL) are independently exercised.
FunnelStepForm.identity.spec.ts.litmus_result: passed — the test exercises the real component submit path and asserts on concrete ids, not mock call counts

funnel-editor.spec.ts_new_tests.assessment: load-bearing. Test 1 (page-level repro) emits 'update:steps' directly on FunnelCanvas and inspects the exact PATCH body passed to storeMock.update — asserts persistedDelay.id === 'delay-1' and persistedKb.next === 'delay-1'. A regression to the old code would drop id from the DELAY in the PATCH, causing the id assertion to fail. Test 2 (Fix 2 / remap) mocks the server re-minting the DELAY id to 'delay-NEW' and then inspects FunnelCanvas props after applyResponse — asserts next/targetStepId/entryStepId all updated to 'delay-NEW'. Mock-heavy but legitimately integration-level page wiring; the assertions are on real component props/state, not mock call counts.
funnel-editor.spec.ts_new_tests.litmus_result: passed — both tests catch a real regression

FunnelCanvas.spec.ts_updated_tests.assessment: All four tests are load-bearing. (1) connectionRadius=28: asserts cfg.radius === 28 — would fail if the constant regressed to the old <=12 value. (2) connectionLinePath cursor-following: calls the exposed path builder with two distinct target coordinates and asserts the outputs differ AND contain the target coordinates — would fail if the builder ignored its arguments or center-snapped. (3) forgiving left drop zone: asserts data-left-extend > 12 AND that the inline style contains a negative left value — structural markers that cannot be silently dropped. (4) overlay inert at rest: asserts the node does NOT carry the --droppable class when no drag is active — guards against a regression where pointer-events would always be enabled.
FunnelCanvas.spec.ts_updated_tests.litmus_result: passed — all four catch distinct real regressions
FunnelCanvas.spec.ts_updated_tests.note: Test (4) is the weakest of the four: it only asserts the absence of a CSS class at rest rather than directly checking pointer-events CSS. Acceptable because the class toggling is the mechanism, and a live drag cannot be exercised in jsdom; flagged minor.
